description_en: Queries the Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instances in a region that can be associated with a Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeBindableSmartAccessGateways接口查询指定地域下云连接网实例可绑定的智能接入网关实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-bindable-smart-access-gateways --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ccn-id ccn-fu75a6m4clv7ai0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBindableSmartAccessGateways

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the SAG instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CCN instance
parameters.name: ccn_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query only the SAG instances that belong to another Alibaba Cloud account. Valid values:

false (default): no
true: yes
parameters.help_zh:
是否只查询跨账号所属的智能接入网关实例。取值：

false（默认值）：否。

true：是
parameters.name: cross_account

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含的条目数。默认值为10，最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the SAG instance.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例名称。

名称长度为2~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含的条目数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of SAG instances
TotalCount.description_zh: 智能接入网关实例总数
